description.value: Mountain View Motel & Restaurant sits at Mile 100 on the Alaska Highway in the small community of Wonowon, northern BC, a strategically placed stop on one of North America's great long-distance cycling routes. The two-storey motel includes an on-site restaurant, offering both a bed and a hot meal in a section of highway where services can be widely spaced. Its Alaska Highway milepost location makes it a natural landmark and resupply waypoint for cycle tourers heading to or from Alaska.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM website URL leads to Hotelni.com, a third-party hotel booking aggregator, not the business's own website; the aggregator page contains a placeholder phone number (+1-555-123-4567) and an incorrect address ('Peace River B'), making OSM tags the more reliable source for contact details. No cyclist-specific amenity information is available from either source. The motel is a real 2-storey building at Mile 100 on the Alaska Highway in Wonowon, BC, as corroborated by the OSM address, building tags, and real Canadian phone number.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to Hotelni.com, a third-party hotel booking aggregator, not the business's own website. No authoritative business website could be identified.
The phone number displayed on the Hotelni page (+1-555-123-4567) is clearly a fake placeholder, contradicting the OSM phone number (+1-250-772-3015); OSM number preferred.
The address shown on the Hotelni page ('Peace River B, BC V0C 2N0') does not match the OSM address (Mile 100 Alaska Highway, Wonowon); OSM address preferred.
No cyclist-specific amenity information could be confirmed from available sources — direct contact with the business is recommended for WWC accreditation checklist completion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating motel with restaurant at a named Alaska Highway milepost in Wonowon, BC — a genuine and useful stop for touring cyclists in a remote stretch of the highway.
